   152	
   153	void LogJavaScriptUrlHistogram(LocalDOMWindow* origin_window,
   154	                               const StringView& script) {
   155	  origin_window->CountUse(WebFeature::kExecutedJavaScriptURLFromFrame);
   156	  if (script.length() > 6) {
   157	    return;
   158	  }
   159	
   160	  String stripped_script = script.ToString().StripWhiteSpace().Replace(";", "");
   161	  if (stripped_script == "''" || stripped_script == "\"\"") {
   162	    origin_window->CountUse(WebFeature::kExecutedEmptyJavaScriptURLFromFrame);
   163	  }
   164	}
   165	
   166	}  // namespace
   167	
   168	bool IsBackForwardLoadType(WebFrameLoadType type) {
   169	  return type == WebFrameLoadType::kBackForward;
   170	}
   171	
   172	bool IsBackForwardOrRestore(WebFrameLoadType type) {
   173	  return type == WebFrameLoadType::kBackForward ||
   174	         type == WebFrameLoadType::kRestore;
   175	}
   176	
   177	bool IsRestoreLoadType(WebFrameLoadType type) {
   178	  return type == WebFrameLoadType::kRestore;
   179	}
   180	
   181	bool IsReloadLoadType(WebFrameLoadType type) {
   182	  return type == WebFrameLoadType::kReload ||
   183	         type == WebFrameLoadType::kReloadBypassingCache;
   184	}
   185	
   186	bool FrameLoader::NeedsHistoryItemRestore(WebFrameLoadType type) {
   187	  return IsBackForwardOrRestore(type) || IsReloadLoadType(type);
   188	}
   189	
   190	ResourceRequest FrameLoader::ResourceRequestForReload(
   191	    WebFrameLoadType frame_load_type,
   192	    ClientRedirectPolicy client_redirect_policy) {
   193	  DCHECK(IsReloadLoadType(frame_load_type));
   194	  const auto cache_mode =
   195	      frame_load_type == WebFrameLoadType::kReloadBypassingCache
   196	          ? mojom::FetchCacheMode::kBypassCache
   197	          : mojom::FetchCacheMode::kValidateCache;
   198	  if (!document_loader_ || !document_loader_->GetHistoryItem())
   199	    return ResourceRequest();
   200	
   201	  ResourceRequest request =
   202	      document_loader_->GetHistoryItem()->GenerateResourceRequest(cache_mode);
   203	
   204	  // ClientRedirectPolicy is an indication that this load was triggered by some
   205	  // direct interaction with the page. If this reload is not a client redirect,
   206	  // we should reuse the referrer and (if applicable) `Origin` header from the
   207	  // original load of the current document. If this reload is a client redirect
   208	  // (e.g., location.reload()), it was initiated by something in the current
   209	  // document and should therefore show the current document's url as the
   210	  // referrer, and, when applicable (i.e., non-HEAD or -GET request), use its
   211	  // current origin as the `Origin` header.
   212	  if (client_redirect_policy == ClientRedirectPolicy::kClientRedirect) {
   213	    LocalDOMWindow* window = frame_->DomWindow();
   214	    Referrer referrer = SecurityPolicy::GenerateReferrer(
   215	        window->GetReferrerPolicy(), window->Url(), window->OutgoingReferrer());
   216	    request.SetReferrerString(referrer.referrer);
   217	    request.SetReferrerPolicy(referrer.referrer_policy);
   218	    request.ClearHTTPOrigin();
   219	  }
   220	
   221	  request.SetSkipServiceWorker(frame_load_type ==
   222	                               WebFrameLoadType::kReloadBypassingCache);
   223	  return request;
   224	}
   225	
   226	FrameLoader::FrameLoader(LocalFrame* frame)
   227	    : frame_(frame),
   228	      progress_tracker_(MakeGarbageCollected<ProgressTracker>(frame)),
   229	      dispatching_did_clear_window_object_in_main_world_(false),
   230	      virtual_time_pauser_(
   231	          frame_->GetFrameScheduler()->CreateWebScopedVirtualTimePauser(
   232	              "FrameLoader",
   233	              WebScopedVirtualTimePauser::VirtualTaskDuration::kInstant)) {
   234	  DCHECK(frame_);
   235	
   236	  TRACE_EVENT_INSTANT("loading", "FrameLoader:created",
   237	                      perfetto::Flow::FromPointer(this, "FrameLoader"));
   238	  TakeObjectSnapshot();
   239	}
   240	
   241	FrameLoader::~FrameLoader() {
   242	  DCHECK_EQ(state_, State::kDetached);
   243	}
   244	
   245	void FrameLoader::Trace(Visitor* visitor) const {
   246	  visitor->Trace(frame_);
   247	  visitor->Trace(progress_tracker_);
   248	  visitor->Trace(document_loader_);
   249	  visitor->Trace(previous_document_loader_for_xslt_);
   250	}
   251	
   252	void FrameLoader::Init(
   253	    const DocumentToken& document_token,
   254	    const InitiatorStateToken& initiator_state_token,
   255	    std::unique_ptr<PolicyContainer> policy_container,
   256	    const StorageKey& storage_key,
   257	    ukm::SourceId document_ukm_source_id,
   258	    const KURL& creator_base_url,
   259	    std::unique_ptr<base::UnguessableToken> sandbox_origin_token) {
   260	  DCHECK(policy_container);
   261	  ScriptForbiddenScope forbid_scripts;
   262	
   263	  // Load the initial empty document:
   264	  auto navigation_params = std::make_unique<WebNavigationParams>();
   265	  navigation_params->url = KURL(g_empty_string);
   266	  if (!creator_base_url.IsEmpty()) {
   267	    navigation_params->fallback_base_url = creator_base_url;
   268	  }
   269	  navigation_params->storage_key = storage_key;
   270	  navigation_params->document_token = document_token;
   271	  navigation_params->initiator_state_token = initiator_state_token;
   272	  navigation_params->frame_policy =
   273	      frame_->Owner() ? frame_->Owner()->GetFramePolicy() : FramePolicy();
   274	  navigation_params->document_ukm_source_id = document_ukm_source_id;
   275	  if (base::FeatureList::IsEnabled(
   276	          blink::features::kUseSandboxTokenForOriginDerivation)) {
   277	    if ((policy_container->GetPolicies().sandbox_flags &
   278	         network::mojom::blink::WebSandboxFlags::kOrigin) !=
   279	        network::mojom::blink::WebSandboxFlags::kNone) {
   280	      CHECK(sandbox_origin_token);
   281	      navigation_params->sandbox_origin_token = std::move(sandbox_origin_token);
   282	    }
   283	  }
   284	
   285	  DocumentLoader* new_document_loader = MakeGarbageCollected<DocumentLoader>(
   286	      frame_, kWebNavigationTypeOther, std::move(navigation_params),
   287	      std::move(policy_container), nullptr /* extra_data */);
   288	
   289	  CommitDocumentLoader(new_document_loader, nullptr,
   290	                       CommitReason::kInitialization);
   291	
   292	  frame_->GetDocument()->CancelParsing();
   293	
   294	  // Suppress finish notifications for initial empty documents, since they don't
   295	  // generate start notifications.
   296	  document_loader_->SetSentDidFinishLoad();
   297	  // Ensure that the frame sees the correct page lifecycle state.
   298	  frame_->OnPageLifecycleStateUpdated();
   299	
   300	  TakeObjectSnapshot();
   301	
   302	  state_ = State::kInitialized;
   303	}
   304	
   305	LocalFrameClient* FrameLoader::Client() const {
   306	  return frame_->Client();
   307	}
   308	
   309	ClientRedirectPolicy CalculateClientRedirectPolicy(
   310	    ClientNavigationReason client_navigation_reason,
   311	    WebFrameLoadType frame_load_type,
   312	    bool is_on_initial_empty_document) {
   313	  if (is_on_initial_empty_document ||
   314	      client_navigation_reason == ClientNavigationReason::kNone ||
   315	      client_navigation_reason ==
   316	          ClientNavigationReason::kInitialFrameNavigation ||
   317	      client_navigation_reason == ClientNavigationReason::kFormSubmissionGet ||
   318	      client_navigation_reason == ClientNavigationReason::kFormSubmissionPost ||
   319	      client_navigation_reason == ClientNavigationReason::kAnchorClick) {
   320	    // Navigations away from the initial empty document and some types of
   321	    // navigations like form submission shouldn't be considered as client
   322	    // redirects, because they're not actually caused by a script redirecting to
   323	    // a different URL.
   324	    return ClientRedirectPolicy::kNotClientRedirect;
   325	  }
   326	  // If the ClientRedirectReason is kFrameNavigation, only treat as a client
   327	  // redirect if the WebFrameLoadType is kReplaceCurrentItem. If this check is
   328	  // not applied, an anchor location change is classified as client redirect
   329	  // and an incorrect redirect chain is formed. On deleting one entry of this
   330	  // redirect chain, the whole chain gets deleted. This result in
   331	  // deletion of multiple items on deleting one item in history.
   332	  // https://crbug.com/1138096
   333	  if (client_navigation_reason == ClientNavigationReason::kFrameNavigation &&
   334	      frame_load_type != WebFrameLoadType::kReplaceCurrentItem)
   335	    return ClientRedirectPolicy::kNotClientRedirect;
   336	  return ClientRedirectPolicy::kClientRedirect;
   337	}
   338	
   339	void FrameLoader::SetDefersLoading(LoaderFreezeMode mode) {
   340	  if (frame_->GetDocument())
   341	    frame_->GetDocument()->Fetcher()->SetDefersLoading(mode);
   342	  if (document_loader_)
   343	    document_loader_->SetDefersLoading(mode);
   344	}
   345	
   346	void FrameLoader::SaveScrollAnchor() {
   347	  if (!document_loader_ || !document_loader_->GetHistoryItem() ||
   348	      !frame_->View())
   349	    return;
   350	
   351	  // Shouldn't clobber anything if we might still restore later.
   352	  if (NeedsHistoryItemRestore(document_loader_->LoadType()) &&
   353	      !document_loader_->GetInitialScrollState().was_scrolled_by_user)
   354	    return;
   355	
   356	  HistoryItem* history_item = document_loader_->GetHistoryItem();
   357	  if (ScrollableArea* layout_scrollable_area =
   358	          frame_->View()->LayoutViewport()) {
   359	    ScrollAnchor* scroll_anchor = layout_scrollable_area->GetScrollAnchor();
   360	    DCHECK(scroll_anchor);
   361	
   362	    const SerializedAnchor& serialized_anchor =
   363	        scroll_anchor->GetSerializedAnchor();
   364	    if (serialized_anchor.IsValid()) {
   365	      auto offset = serialized_anchor.GetScrollOffset(*layout_scrollable_area);
   366	      history_item->SetScrollAnchorData({serialized_anchor.selector,
   367	                                         gfx::PointF(offset.x(), offset.y()),
   368	                                         serialized_anchor.simhash});
   369	    }
   370	  }
   371	}
   372	
   373	void FrameLoader::SaveScrollState() {
   374	  if (!document_loader_ || !document_loader_->GetHistoryItem() ||
   375	      !frame_->View())
   376	    return;
   377	
   378	  // Shouldn't clobber anything if we might still restore later.
   379	  if (NeedsHistoryItemRestore(document_loader_->LoadType()) &&
   380	      !document_loader_->GetInitialScrollState().was_scrolled_by_user)
   381	    return;
   382	
   383	  HistoryItem* history_item = document_loader_->GetHistoryItem();
   384	  // For performance reasons, we don't save scroll anchors as often as we save
   385	  // scroll offsets. In order to avoid keeping around a stale anchor, we clear
   386	  // it when the saved scroll offset changes.
   387	  history_item->SetScrollAnchorData(ScrollAnchorData());
   388	  if (ScrollableArea* layout_scrollable_area = frame_->View()->LayoutViewport())
   389	    history_item->SetScrollOffset(layout_scrollable_area->GetScrollOffset());
   390	
   391	  VisualViewport& visual_viewport = frame_->GetPage()->GetVisualViewport();
   392	  if (frame_->IsMainFrame() && visual_viewport.IsActiveViewport()) {
   393	    history_item->SetVisualViewportScrollOffset(
   394	        visual_viewport.VisibleRect().OffsetFromOrigin());
   395	    history_item->SetPageScaleFactor(visual_viewport.Scale());
   396	  }
   397	
   398	  Client()->DidUpdateCurrentHistoryItem();
   399	}
   400	
   401	void FrameLoader::DispatchUnloadEventAndFillOldDocumentInfoIfNeeded(
   402	    bool will_commit_new_document_in_this_frame) {
   403	  TRACE_EVENT0("navigation",
   404	               "FrameLoader::DispatchUnloadEventAndFillOldDocInfo");
   405	  const std::string_view histogram_suffix =
   406	      will_commit_new_document_in_this_frame ? "CommitInFrame" : "Other";
   407	  base::ScopedUmaHistogramTimer histogram_timer(base::StrCat(
   408	      {"Navigation.FrameLoader.DispatchUnloadEventAndFillOldDocInfo.",
   409	       histogram_suffix}));
   410	  FrameNavigationDisabler navigation_disabler(*frame_);
   411	  SaveScrollState();
   412	
   413	  if (SVGImage::IsInSVGImage(frame_->GetDocument()))
   414	    return;
   415	
   416	  // Only fill in the info of the unloading document if it is needed for a new
   417	  // document committing in this frame (either due to frame swap or committing
   418	  // a new document in the same FrameLoader). This avoids overwriting the info
   419	  // saved of a parent frame that's already saved in
   420	  // ScopedOldDocumentInfoForCommitCapturer when a child frame is being
   421	  // destroyed due to the parent frame committing. In that case, only the parent
   422	  // frame needs should fill in the info.
   423	  OldDocumentInfoForCommit* old_document_info =
   424	      ScopedOldDocumentInfoForCommitCapturer::CurrentInfo();
   425	  if (!old_document_info || !will_commit_new_document_in_this_frame ||
   426	      !GetDocumentLoader()) {
   427	    frame_->GetDocument()->DispatchUnloadEvents(
   428	        nullptr, will_commit_new_document_in_this_frame);
   429	    return;
   430	  }
   431	  old_document_info->history_item = GetDocumentLoader()->GetHistoryItem();
   432	  if (auto* scheduler = frame_->GetFrameScheduler()) {
   433	    old_document_info->frame_scheduler_unreported_task_time =
   434	        scheduler->UnreportedTaskTime();
   435	  }
   436	  old_document_info->was_focused_frame =
   437	      (frame_->GetPage()->GetFocusController().FocusedFrame() == frame_);
   438	  old_document_info->overlay_color = frame_->GetFrameOverlayColor();
   439	
   440	  base::ElapsedTimer elapsed_timer;
   441	  frame_->GetDocument()->DispatchUnloadEvents(
   442	      &old_document_info->unload_timing_info,
   443	      will_commit_new_document_in_this_frame);
   444	  old_document_info->total_lifecycle_events_processing_time_on_commit =
   445	      std::max(
   446	          old_document_info->total_lifecycle_events_processing_time_on_commit,
   447	          elapsed_timer.Elapsed());
   448	}
   449	
   450	void FrameLoader::DidExplicitOpen() {
   451	  probe::DidOpenDocument(frame_.Get(), GetDocumentLoader());
   452	  if (initial_empty_document_status_ ==
   453	      InitialEmptyDocumentStatus::kInitialOrSynchronousAboutBlank) {
   454	    initial_empty_document_status_ = InitialEmptyDocumentStatus::
   455	        kInitialOrSynchronousAboutBlankButExplicitlyOpened;
   456	  }
   457	
   458	  // Only model a document.open() as part of a navigation if its parent is not
   459	  // done or in the process of completing.
   460	  if (Frame* parent = frame_->Tree().Parent()) {
   461	    auto* parent_local_frame = DynamicTo<LocalFrame>(parent);
   462	    if ((parent_local_frame &&
   463	         parent_local_frame->GetDocument()->LoadEventStillNeeded()) ||
   464	        (parent->IsRemoteFrame() && parent->IsLoading())) {
   465	      progress_tracker_->ProgressStarted();
   466	    }
   467	  }
   468	}
   469	
   470	void FrameLoader::FinishedParsing() {
   471	  if (state_ == State::kUninitialized)
   472	    return;
   473	
   474	  progress_tracker_->FinishedParsing();
   475	
   476	  frame_->GetLocalFrameHostRemote().DidDispatchDOMContentLoadedEvent();
   477	
   478	  if (Client()) {
   479	    ScriptForbiddenScope forbid_scripts;
   480	    Client()->DispatchDidDispatchDOMContentLoadedEvent();
   481	  }
   482	
   483	  if (Client()) {
   484	    Client()->RunScriptsAtDocumentReady(
   485	        !document_loader_ || document_loader_->IsCommittedButEmpty());
   486	  }
   487	
   488	  bool has_text_fragment = false;
   489	  if (frame_->GetDocument()) {
   490	    has_text_fragment = !frame_->GetDocument()
   491	                             ->fragmentDirective()
   492	                             .GetDirectives<TextDirective>()
   493	                             .empty();
   494	    if (!has_text_fragment && document_loader_) {
   495	      has_text_fragment = document_loader_->HasInternalScrollToTextFragment();
   496	    }
   497	  }
   498	
   499	  if (!has_text_fragment ||
   500	      (frame_->View() && frame_->GetPage() &&
   501	       frame_->GetPage()->RelatedPagesMutationFromPreviousPageFinalized())) {
   502	    ProcessFragment(frame_->GetDocument()->Url(), document_loader_->LoadType(),
   503	                    kNavigationToDifferentDocument);
   504	  } else {
   505	    // TODO(crbug.com/509527381): Consider adding a timeout to reset this back
   506	    // to false.
   507	    has_pending_cross_document_fragment_ = true;
   508	  }
   509	
   510	  frame_->GetDocument()->CheckCompleted();
   511	}
   512	
   513	// TODO(dgozman): we are calling this method too often, hoping that it
   514	// does not do anything when navigation is in progress, or when loading
   515	// has finished already. We should call it at the right times.
   516	void FrameLoader::DidFinishNavigation(NavigationFinishState state) {
   517	  if (document_loader_) {
   518	    // Only declare the whole frame finished if the committed navigation is done
   519	    // and there is no provisional navigation in progress.
   520	    // The navigation API may prevent a navigation from completing while waiting
   521	    // for a JS-provided promise to resolve, so check it as well.
   522	    if (!document_loader_->SentDidFinishLoad() || HasProvisionalNavigation())
   523	      return;
   524	    if (frame_->DomWindow()->navigation()->HasNonDroppedOngoingNavigation())
   525	      return;
   526	  }
   527	
   528	  // This code in this block is meant to prepare a document for display, but
   529	  // this code may also run when swapping out a provisional frame. In that case,
   530	  // skip the display work.
   531	  if (frame_->IsLoading() && !frame_->IsProvisional()) {
   532	    progress_tracker_->ProgressCompleted();
   533	    // Retry restoring scroll offset since finishing loading disables content
   534	    // size clamping.
   535	    RestoreScrollPositionAndViewState();
   536	    if (document_loader_)
   537	      document_loader_->SetLoadType(WebFrameLoadType::kStandard);
   538	    frame_->FinishedLoading(state);
   539	  }
   540	
   541	  // When a subframe finishes loading, the parent should check if *all*
   542	  // subframes have finished loading (which may mean that the parent can declare
   543	  // that the parent itself has finished loading).  This local-subframe-focused
   544	  // code has a remote-subframe equivalent in
   545	  // WebRemoteFrameImpl::DidStopLoading.
   546	  Frame* parent = frame_->Tree().Parent();
   547	  if (parent)
   548	    parent->CheckCompleted();
   549	}
   550	
   551	bool FrameLoader::AllowPlugins() {
   552	  // With Oilpan, a FrameLoader might be accessed after the Page has been
   553	  // detached. FrameClient will not be accessible, so bail early.
   554	  if (!Client())
   555	    return false;
   556	  Settings* settings = frame_->GetSettings();
   557	  return settings && settings->GetPluginsEnabled();
   558	}
   559	
   560	void FrameLoader::DetachDocumentLoader(Member<DocumentLoader>& loader,
   561	                                       bool flush_microtask_queue) {
   562	  if (!loader)
   563	    return;
   564	
   565	  FrameNavigationDisabler navigation_disabler(*frame_);
   566	  loader->DetachFromFrame(flush_microtask_queue);
   567	  loader = nullptr;
   568	}
   569	
   570	void FrameLoader::ProcessScrollForSameDocumentNavigation(
   571	    const KURL& url,
   572	    WebFrameLoadType frame_load_type,
   573	    std::optional<HistoryItem::ViewState> view_state,
   574	    mojom::blink::ScrollRestorationType scroll_restoration_type,
   575	    mojom::blink::ScrollBehavior scroll_behavior) {
   576	  if (view_state) {
   577	    RestoreScrollPositionAndViewState(frame_load_type, *view_state,
   578	                                      scroll_restoration_type, scroll_behavior);
   579	  }
   580	
   581	  // We need to scroll to the fragment whether or not a hash change occurred,
   582	  // since the user might have scrolled since the previous navigation.
   583	  if (url.HasFragmentIdentifier()) {
   584	    // If the same-document navigation explicitly navigates to a fragment, abort
   585	    // any pending cross-document text fragment and process the new fragment
   586	    // immediately.
   587	    has_pending_cross_document_fragment_ = false;
   588	    ProcessFragment(url, frame_load_type, kNavigationWithinSameDocument);
   589	  } else if (!has_pending_cross_document_fragment_ ||
   590	             (frame_->View() && frame_->GetPage() &&
   591	              frame_->GetPage()
   592	                  ->RelatedPagesMutationFromPreviousPageFinalized())) {
   593	    // Avoid prematurely processing a deferred cross-document text fragment
   594	    // until related pages state is finalized.
   595	    ProcessFragment(url, frame_load_type, kNavigationWithinSameDocument);
   596	    has_pending_cross_document_fragment_ = false;
   597	  }
   598	
   599	  TakeObjectSnapshot();
   600	}
   601	
   602	bool FrameLoader::AllowRequestForThisFrame(const FrameLoadRequest& request) {
   603	  // If no origin Document* was specified, skip remaining security checks and
   604	  // assume the caller has fully initialized the FrameLoadRequest.
   605	  if (!request.GetOriginWindow())
   606	    return true;
   607	
   608	  const KURL& url = request.GetResourceRequest().Url();
   609	  if (url.ProtocolIsJavaScript()) {
   610	    if (!request.GetOriginWindow()->AllowInlineJavascriptUrl(
   611	            request.JavascriptWorld(), url, frame_->DeprecatedLocalOwner())) {
   612	      return false;
   613	    }
   614	    if (frame_->Owner() && ((frame_->Owner()->GetFramePolicy().sandbox_flags &
   615	                             network::mojom::blink::WebSandboxFlags::kOrigin) !=
   616	                            network::mojom::blink::WebSandboxFlags::kNone)) {
   617	      return false;
   618	    }
   619	  }
   620	
   621	  if (!request.CanDisplay(url)) {
   622	    request.GetOriginWindow()->AddConsoleMessage(
   623	        MakeGarbageCollected<ConsoleMessage>(
   624	            mojom::ConsoleMessageSource::kSecurity,
   625	            mojom::ConsoleMessageLevel::kError,
   626	            StrCat(
   627	                {"Not allowed to load local resource: ", url.ElidedString()})));
   628	    return false;
   629	  }
   630	  return true;
   631	}
   632	
   633	static WebNavigationType DetermineNavigationType(
   634	    WebFrameLoadType frame_load_type,
   635	    bool is_form_submission,
   636	    bool have_event) {
   637	  bool is_reload = IsReloadLoadType(frame_load_type);
   638	  bool is_back_forward = IsBackForwardLoadType(frame_load_type);
   639	  bool is_restore = IsRestoreLoadType(frame_load_type);
   640	  if (is_form_submission) {
   641	    if (is_reload)
   642	      return kWebNavigationTypeFormResubmittedReload;
   643	    if (is_back_forward)
   644	      return kWebNavigationTypeFormResubmittedBackForward;
   645	    return kWebNavigationTypeFormSubmitted;
   646	  }
   647	  if (have_event)
   648	    return kWebNavigationTypeLinkClicked;
   649	  if (is_reload)
   650	    return kWebNavigationTypeReload;
   651	  if (is_back_forward)
   652	    return kWebNavigationTypeBackForward;
   653	  if (is_restore) {
   654	    return kWebNavigationTypeRestore;
   655	  }
   656	  return kWebNavigationTypeOther;
   657	}
   658	
   659	static mojom::blink::RequestContextType
   660	DetermineRequestContextFromNavigationType(
   661	    const WebNavigationType navigation_type) {
   662	  switch (navigation_type) {
   663	    case kWebNavigationTypeLinkClicked:
   664	      return mojom::blink::RequestContextType::HYPERLINK;
   665	
   666	    case kWebNavigationTypeOther:
   667	      return mojom::blink::RequestContextType::LOCATION;
   668	
   669	    case kWebNavigationTypeFormResubmittedBackForward:
   670	    case kWebNavigationTypeFormResubmittedReload:
   671	    case kWebNavigationTypeFormSubmitted:
   672	      return mojom::blink::RequestContextType::FORM;
   673	
   674	    case kWebNavigationTypeBackForward:
   675	    case kWebNavigationTypeReload:
   676	    case kWebNavigationTypeRestore:
   677	      return mojom::blink::RequestContextType::INTERNAL;
   678	  }
   679	  NOTREACHED();
   680	}
   681	
   682	static network::mojom::RequestDestination
   683	DetermineRequestDestinationFromNavigationType(
   684	    const WebNavigationType navigation_type) {
   685	  switch (navigation_type) {
   686	    case kWebNavigationTypeLinkClicked:
   687	    case kWebNavigationTypeOther:
   688	    case kWebNavigationTypeFormResubmittedBackForward:
   689	    case kWebNavigationTypeFormResubmittedReload:
   690	    case kWebNavigationTypeFormSubmitted:
   691	      return network::mojom::RequestDestination::kDocument;
   692	    case kWebNavigationTypeBackForward:
   693	    case kWebNavigationTypeReload:
   694	    case kWebNavigationTypeRestore:
   695	      return network::mojom::RequestDestination::kEmpty;
   696	  }
   697	  NOTREACHED();
   698	}
   699	
   700	void FrameLoader::StartNavigation(FrameLoadRequest& request,
   701	                                  WebFrameLoadType frame_load_type) {
   702	  CHECK(!IsBackForwardOrRestore(frame_load_type));
   703	  DCHECK(request.GetTriggeringEventInfo() !=
   704	         mojom::blink::TriggeringEventInfo::kUnknown);
   705	  DCHECK(frame_->GetDocument());
   706	  if (HTMLFrameOwnerElement* element = frame_->DeprecatedLocalOwner())
   707	    element->CancelPendingLazyLoad();
   708	
   709	  ResourceRequest& resource_request = request.GetResourceRequest();
   710	  String script_injector_host;
   711	  if (GetDocumentLoader() &&
   712	      GetDocumentLoader()->GetScriptInjectionPolicy() ==
   713	          mojom::blink::ScriptInjectionPolicy::kNavigationProtection) {
   714	    if (auto* extension_script_tracker = frame_->GetExtensionScriptTracker()) {
   715	      script_injector_host = extension_script_tracker->ExtensionScriptInStack();
   716	    }
   717	  }
   718	  const KURL& url = resource_request.Url();
   719	  LocalDOMWindow* origin_window = request.GetOriginWindow();
   720	
   721	  if (SchemeRegistry::IsDirectLaunchScheme(url.Protocol())) {
   722	    // TODO(crbug.com/517967197): Explore stripping the direct launch scheme
   723	    // prefix and continuing as a standard renderer-initiated navigation for web
   724	    // compatibility.
   725	    if (frame_->GetDocument()) {
   726	      frame_->GetDocument()->AddConsoleMessage(
   727	          MakeGarbageCollected<ConsoleMessage>(
   728	              mojom::blink::ConsoleMessageSource::kSecurity,
   729	              mojom::blink::ConsoleMessageLevel::kError,
   730	              StrCat({"Not allowed to navigate to direct-launch scheme '",
   731	                      url.Protocol(), "' from web contexts."})));
   732	    }
   733	    return;
   734	  }
   735	
   736	  TRACE_EVENT2("navigation", "FrameLoader::StartNavigation", "url",
   737	               url.GetString().Utf8(), "load_type",
   738	               static_cast<int>(frame_load_type));
   739	
   740	  if (!AllowRequestForThisFrame(request))
   741	    return;
   742	
   743	  // Block renderer-initiated loads of data: and filesystem: URLs in the top
   744	  // frame (unless they are reload requests).
   745	  //
   746	  // If the mime type of the data URL is supported, the URL will
   747	  // eventually be rendered, so block it here. Otherwise, the load might be
   748	  // handled by a plugin or end up as a download, so allow it to let the
   749	  // embedder figure out what to do with it. Navigations to filesystem URLs are
   750	  // always blocked here.
   751	  if (frame_->IsMainFrame() && origin_window &&
   752	      request.GetClientNavigationReason() != ClientNavigationReason::kReload &&
   753	      !frame_->Client()->AllowContentInitiatedDataUrlNavigations(
   754	          origin_window->Url()) &&
   755	      (url.ProtocolIs("filesystem") ||
   756	       (url.ProtocolIsData() &&
   757	        network_utils::IsDataURLMimeTypeSupported(url)))) {
   758	    frame_->GetDocument()->AddConsoleMessage(
   759	        MakeGarbageCollected<ConsoleMessage>(
   760	            mojom::blink::ConsoleMessageSource::kSecurity,
   761	            mojom::blink::ConsoleMessageLevel::kError,
   762	            StrCat({"Not allowed to navigate top frame to ", url.Protocol(),
   763	                    " URL: ", url.ElidedString()})));
   764	    return;
   765	  }
   766	
   767	  // TODO(dgozman): merge page dismissal check and FrameNavigationDisabler.
   768	  if (!frame_->IsNavigationAllowed() ||
   769	      frame_->GetDocument()->PageDismissalEventBeingDispatched() !=
   770	          Document::kNoDismissal) {
   771	    return;
   772	  }
   773	
   774	  if (url.ProtocolIs("filesystem")) {
   775	    document_loader_->CountUse(
   776	        mojom::blink::WebFeature::kFileSystemUrlNavigation);
   777	  }
   778	
   779	  // Convert navigations from the initial empty document to do replacement if
   780	  // needed. Note that we don't convert reloads or history navigations (so only
   781	  // kStandard navigations can get converted to do replacement).
   782	  if (frame_load_type == WebFrameLoadType::kStandard &&
   783	      IsOnInitialEmptyDocument()) {
   784	    frame_load_type = WebFrameLoadType::kReplaceCurrentItem;
   785	  }
   786	
   787	  bool same_document_navigation =
   788	      request.GetNavigationPolicy() == kNavigationPolicyCurrentTab &&
   789	      ShouldPerformFragmentNavigation(
   790	          request.Form(), resource_request.HttpMethod(), frame_load_type, url);
   791	
   792	  if (RuntimeEnabledFeatures::
   793	          TreatMhtmlInitialDocumentLoadsAsCrossDocumentEnabled()) {
   794	    if (auto* parent = DynamicTo<LocalFrame>(frame_->Tree().Parent())) {
   795	      // Within MHTML archives, treat the initial about:blank#fragment
   796	      // navigation as cross-document. Although it appears to be a same-document
   797	      // fragment navigation, it actually commits a new document with a new
   798	      // opaque origin.
   799	      //
   800	      // TODO(crbug.com/423663315): Consider refining this logic to only treat
   801	      // the initial about:blank#fragment navigation in MHTML as cross-document
   802	      // if the MHTML archive actually overrides the about:blank resource. If it
   803	      // doesn't, the navigation may be better treated as same-document,
   804	      // matching non-MHTML behavior.
   805	      if (parent->Loader().GetDocumentLoader()->HasBeenLoadedAsWebArchive()) {
   806	        if (url.HasFragmentIdentifier() &&
   807	            frame_->GetDocument()->IsInitialEmptyDocument()) {
   808	          same_document_navigation = false;
   809	        }
   810	      }
   811	    }
   812	  }
   813	
   814	  // Perform same document navigation.
   815	  if (same_document_navigation) {
   816	    DCHECK(origin_window);
   817	    document_loader_->CommitSameDocumentNavigation(
   818	        url, frame_load_type, nullptr,
   819	        CalculateClientRedirectPolicy(request.GetClientNavigationReason(),
   820	                                      frame_load_type,
   821	                                      IsOnInitialEmptyDocument()),
   822	        resource_request.HasUserGesture(), origin_window->GetSecurityOrigin(),
   823	        /*is_synchronously_committed=*/true, request.GetSourceElement(),
   824	        request.GetTriggeringEventInfo(), /*is_browser_initiated=*/false,
   825	        /*has_ua_visual_transition*/ false,
   826	        /*soft_navigation_heuristics_task_id=*/std::nullopt,
   827	        /*should_skip_screenshot=*/false);
   828	    return;
   829	  }
   830	
   831	  // If we're navigating and there's still a text fragment permission token on
   832	  // the document loader, it means this navigation didn't try to invoke a text
   833	  // fragment. In this case, we want to propagate this to the next document to
   834	  // allow text-fragments across client-side redirects.
   835	  bool text_fragment_token = GetDocumentLoader()->ConsumeTextFragmentToken();
   836	
   837	  resource_request.SetHasTextFragmentToken(text_fragment_token);
   838	
   839	  WebNavigationType navigation_type = DetermineNavigationType(
   840	      frame_load_type, resource_request.HttpBody() || request.Form(),
   841	      request.GetTriggeringEventInfo() !=
   842	          mojom::blink::TriggeringEventInfo::kNotFromEvent);
   843	  mojom::blink::RequestContextType request_context_type =
   844	      DetermineRequestContextFromNavigationType(navigation_type);
   845	
   846	  // TODO(lyf): handle `frame` context type. https://crbug.com/1019716
   847	  if (mojom::blink::RequestContextType::LOCATION == request_context_type &&
   848	      !frame_->IsMainFrame()) {
   849	    request_context_type = mojom::blink::RequestContextType::IFRAME;
   850	  }
   851	  resource_request.SetRequestContext(request_context_type);
   852	  resource_request.SetRequestDestination(
   853	      DetermineRequestDestinationFromNavigationType(navigation_type));
   854	  request.SetFrameType(frame_->IsMainFrame()
   855	                           ? mojom::RequestContextFrameType::kTopLevel
   856	                           : mojom::RequestContextFrameType::kNested);
   857	
   858	  // TODO(arthursonzogni): 'frame-src' check is disabled on the
   859	  // renderer side, but is enforced on the browser side.
   860	  // See http://crbug.com/692595 for understanding why it
   861	  // can't be enforced on both sides instead.
   862	
   863	  // 'form-action' check in the frame that is navigating is disabled on the
   864	  // renderer side, but is enforced on the browser side instead.
   865	  // N.B. check in the frame that initiates the navigation stills occurs in
   866	  // blink and is not enforced on the browser-side.
   867	  // TODO(arthursonzogni) The 'form-action' check should be fully disabled
   868	  // in blink, except when the form submission doesn't trigger a navigation
   869	  // (i.e. javascript urls). Please see https://crbug.com/701749.
   870	
   871	  // Report-only CSP headers are checked in browser.
   872	  const FetchClientSettingsObject* fetch_client_settings_object = nullptr;
   873	  if (origin_window) {
   874	    fetch_client_settings_object = &origin_window->Fetcher()
   875	                                        ->GetProperties()
   876	                                        .GetFetchClientSettingsObject();
   877	  }
   878	  ModifyRequestForCSP(resource_request, fetch_client_settings_object,
   879	                      origin_window, request.GetFrameType());
   880	
   881	  DCHECK(Client()->HasWebView());
   882	  // Check for non-escaped new lines in the url.
   883	  if (url.PotentiallyDanglingMarkup() && url.ProtocolIsInHttpFamily()) {
   884	    Deprecation::CountDeprecation(
   885	        origin_window, WebFeature::kCanRequestURLHTTPContainingNewline);
   886	    return;
   887	  }
   888	
   889	  if (url.ProtocolIsJavaScript()) {
   890	    // If the navigation policy does not target the current frame (for example,
   891	    // a navigation initiated by Ctrl/Cmd+Click on an anchor element),
   892	    // `FindOrCreateFrameForNavigation()` returns the initiator frame, expecting
   893	    // the navigation to end up in the browser process so the browser process
   894	    // can handle the navigation policy accordingly.
   895	    //
   896	    // However, before this navigation is sent to the browser process, Blink
   897	    // checks if it's a javascript: URL, since that is always supposed to be
   898	    // handled internally in the renderer. It is certainly not correct to
   899	    // evaluate the javascript: URL in the initiator frame if the navigation is
   900	    // not targeting the current frame.
   901	    if (request.GetNavigationPolicy() == kNavigationPolicyCurrentTab) {
   902	      if (!origin_window ||
   903	          origin_window->CanExecuteScripts(kAboutToExecuteScript)) {
   904	        if (origin_window &&
   905	            request.GetFrameType() ==
   906	                mojom::blink::RequestContextFrameType::kNested) {
   907	          LogJavaScriptUrlHistogram(origin_window, url.GetPath());
   908	        }
   909	
   910	        frame_->GetDocument()->ProcessJavaScriptUrl(url,
   911	                                                    request.JavascriptWorld());
   912	      } else {
   913	        // Any possible navigation policy that ends up creating a new browsing
   914	        // context will create a browsing context with no opener relation. The
   915	        // new browsing context will always be cross-origin because the new
   916	        // window starts at the initial empty document—and since it does have an
   917	        // opener, it will not inherit an origin and will have a new unique
   918	        // opaque origin. It would be incorrect to execute the javascript: URL
   919	        // in a cross-origin context, so intentionally do nothing.
   920	      }
   921	    }
   922	    return;
   923	  }
   924	
   925	  // Do not navigate to an invalid "javascript:" scheme URL under the standard
   926	  // compliant non special scheme url parsing.
   927	  //
   928	  // See wpt/url/javascript-urls.window.js test for the standard compliant
   929	  // behaviors.
   930	  if (ProtocolIsJavaScript(url.GetString()) && !url.IsValid()) {
   931	    return;
   932	  }
   933	
   934	  if (request.GetNavigationPolicy() == kNavigationPolicyCurrentTab &&
   935	      (!origin_window || origin_window->GetSecurityOrigin()->CanAccess(
   936	                             frame_->DomWindow()->GetSecurityOrigin()))) {
   937	    auto* params = MakeGarbageCollected<NavigateEventDispatchParams>(
   938	        url, NavigateEventType::kCrossDocument, frame_load_type);
   939	    params->source_element = request.GetSourceElement();
   940	    if (request.GetTriggeringEventInfo() ==
   941	        mojom::blink::TriggeringEventInfo::kFromTrustedEvent) {
   942	      params->involvement = UserNavigationInvolvement::kActivation;
   943	    }
   944	    if (frame_->DomWindow()->navigation()->DispatchNavigateEvent(params) !=
   945	        NavigationApi::DispatchResult::kContinue) {
   946	      return;
   947	    }
   948	
   949	    request.SetResumeDeferredCommitListener(
   950	        std::move(params->resume_deferred_commit_listener));
   951	  }
   952	
   953	  // https://whatpr.org/html/10903/d1c086a...0e0afb3/browsing-the-web.html#beginning-navigation
   954	  // If sourceDocument is navigable's container document, then reserve deferred
   955	  // fetch quota for navigable's container given url's origin.
   956	  if (IsFetchLaterUseDeferredFetchPolicyEnabled() && origin_window &&
   957	      origin_window->GetFrame() == frame_->Parent()) {
   958	    if (auto* owner = DynamicTo<HTMLFrameOwnerElement>(frame_->Owner());
   959	        owner) {
   960	      // Determine the origin of the navigation target `url`.
   961	      // This is not available from `frame` security context yet as navigation
   962	      // is just starting. It has to take frame's sandbox flags into account.
   963	      scoped_refptr<const SecurityOrigin> to_origin =
   964	          SecurityOrigin::Create(url);
   965	      if ((owner->GetFramePolicy().sandbox_flags &
   966	           network::mojom::blink::WebSandboxFlags::kOrigin) !=
   967	          network::mojom::blink::WebSandboxFlags::kNone) {
   968	        to_origin = to_origin->DeriveNewOpaqueOrigin();
   969	      }
   970	      owner->UpdateDeferredFetchPolicy(std::move(to_origin));
   971	    }
   972	  }
   973	
   974	  if (frame_->IsMainFrame())
   975	    LocalFrame::ConsumeTransientUserActivation(frame_);
   976	
   977	  // The main resource request gets logged here, because V8DOMActivityLogger
   978	  // is looked up based on the current v8::Context. When the request actually
   979	  // begins, the v8::Context may no longer be on the stack.
   980	  if (V8DOMActivityLogger* activity_logger =
   981	          V8DOMActivityLogger::CurrentActivityLoggerIfIsolatedWorld(
   982	              frame_->DomWindow()->GetIsolate())) {
   983	    if (!DocumentLoader::WillLoadUrlAsEmpty(url)) {
   984	      Vector<String> argv;
   985	      argv.push_back("Main resource");
   986	      argv.push_back(url.GetString());
   987	      activity_logger->LogEvent(frame_->DomWindow(), "blinkRequestResource",
   988	                                argv);
   989	    }
   990	  }
   991	
   992	  bool is_form_submission = request.GetClientNavigationReason() ==
   993	                                ClientNavigationReason::kFormSubmissionGet ||
   994	                            request.GetClientNavigationReason() ==
   995	                                ClientNavigationReason::kFormSubmissionPost;
   996	  if (!is_form_submission) {
   997	    // This signal for form submissions is issued earlier when scheduling
   998	    // the form submission task. See Frame::ScheduleFormSubmission.
   999	    probe::FrameRequestedNavigation(frame_.Get(), frame_.Get(), url,
  1000	                                    request.GetClientNavigationReason(),
  1001	                                    request.GetNavigationPolicy());
  1002	  }
  1003	
  1004	  // TODO(crbug.com/896041): Instead of just bypassing the CSP for navigations
  1005	  // from isolated world, ideally we should enforce the isolated world CSP by
  1006	  // plumbing the correct CSP to the browser.
  1007	  using CSPDisposition = network::mojom::CSPDisposition;
  1008	  CSPDisposition should_check_main_world_csp =
  1009	      ContentSecurityPolicy::ShouldBypassMainWorldDeprecated(
  1010	          request.JavascriptWorld())
  1011	          ? CSPDisposition::DO_NOT_CHECK
  1012	          : CSPDisposition::CHECK;
  1013	
  1014	  Client()->BeginNavigation(
  1015	      resource_request, request.GetRequestorBaseURL(), request.GetFrameType(),
  1016	      origin_window, nullptr /* document_loader */, navigation_type,
  1017	      request.GetNavigationPolicy(), frame_load_type,
  1018	      request.ForceHistoryPush(),
  1019	      CalculateClientRedirectPolicy(
  1020	          request.GetClientNavigationReason(), frame_load_type,
  1021	          IsOnInitialEmptyDocument()) == ClientRedirectPolicy::kClientRedirect,
  1022	      request.IsUnfencedTopNavigation(), request.GetTriggeringEventInfo(),
  1023	      request.Form(), should_check_main_world_csp, request.GetBlobURLToken(),
  1024	      request.GetInputStartTime(), request.GetCreationTime(),
  1025	      request.HrefTranslate().GetString(), request.GetInitiatorFrameToken(),
  1026	      request.GetInitiatorStateToken(), request.GetInitiatorDocumentToken(),
  1027	      request.GetSourceLocation(),
  1028	      request.TakeInitiatorNavigationStateKeepAliveHandle(),
  1029	      request.IsContainerInitiated(),
  1030	      request.GetWindowFeatures().explicit_opener,
  1031	      request.TakeResumeDeferredCommitListener(),
  1032	      request.GetScriptToolInvocationId(), script_injector_host);
  1033	}
  1034	
  1035	static void FillStaticResponseIfNeeded(WebNavigationParams* params,
  1036	                                       LocalFrame* frame) {
  1037	  if (params->is_static_data)
  1038	    return;
  1039	
  1040	  const KURL& url = params->url;
  1041	  // See WebNavigationParams for special case explanations.
  1042	  if (url.IsAboutSrcdocUrl()) {
  1043	    CHECK(params->body_loader);
  1044	    // Originally, this branch was responsible for retrieving the value of the
  1045	    // srcdoc attribute and turning it into a body loader when committing a
  1046	    // navigation to about:srcdoc. To support out-of-process sandboxed iframes,
  1047	    // the value of the srcdoc attribute is now sent to the browser in
  1048	    // BeginNavigation, and the body loader should have already been created
  1049	    // by the time the browser asks the renderer to commit, like other
  1050	    // standard navigations.
  1051	    return;
  1052	  }
  1053	
  1054	  MHTMLArchive* archive = nullptr;
  1055	  if (auto* parent = DynamicTo<LocalFrame>(frame->Tree().Parent()))
  1056	    archive = parent->Loader().GetDocumentLoader()->Archive();
  1057	  if (archive && !url.ProtocolIsData()) {
  1058	    // If we have an archive loaded in some ancestor frame, we should
  1059	    // retrieve document content from that archive. This is different from
  1060	    // loading an archive into this frame, which will be handled separately
  1061	    // once we load the body and parse it as an archive.
  1062	    params->body_loader.reset();
  1063	    ArchiveResource* archive_resource = archive->SubresourceForURL(url);
  1064	    if (archive_resource) {
  1065	      WebNavigationParams::FillStaticResponse(
  1066	          params, archive_resource->MimeType(),
  1067	          archive_resource->TextEncoding(), archive_resource->Data());
  1068	    } else {
  1069	      // The requested archive resource does not exist. In an ideal world, this
  1070	      // would commit as a failed navigation, but the browser doesn't know
  1071	      // anything about what resources are available in the archive. Just
  1072	      // synthesize an empty document so that something commits still.
  1073	      // TODO(https://crbug.com/1112965): remove these special cases by adding
  1074	      // an URLLoaderFactory implementation for MHTML archives.
  1075	      WebNavigationParams::FillStaticResponse(
  1076	          params, "text/html", "UTF-8",
  1077	          base::span_from_cstring(
  1078	              "<html><body>"
  1079	              "<!-- failed to find resource in MHTML archive -->"
  1080	              "</body></html>"));
  1081	    }
  1082	  }
  1083	
  1084	  // Checking whether a URL would load as empty (e.g. about:blank) must be done
  1085	  // after checking for content with the corresponding URL in the MHTML archive,
  1086	  // since MHTML archives can define custom content to load for about:blank...
  1087	  //
  1088	  // Note that no static response needs to be filled here; instead, this is
  1089	  // synthesised later by `DocumentLoader::InitializeEmptyResponse()`.
  1090	  if (DocumentLoader::WillLoadUrlAsEmpty(params->url))
  1091	    return;
  1092	
  1093	  const String& mime_type = params->response.MimeType();
  1094	  if (MIMETypeRegistry::IsSupportedMIMEType(mime_type))
  1095	    return;
  1096	
  1097	  PluginData* plugin_data = frame->GetPluginData();
  1098	  if (!mime_type.empty() && plugin_data &&
  1099	      plugin_data->SupportsMimeType(mime_type)) {
  1100	    return;
  1101	  }
  1102	
  1103	  // Typically, PlzNavigate checks that the MIME type can be handled on the
  1104	  // browser side before sending it to the renderer. However, there are rare
  1105	  // scenarios where it's possible for the renderer to send a commit request
  1106	  // with a MIME type the renderer cannot handle:
  1107	  //
  1108	  // - (hypothetical) some sort of race between enabling/disabling plugins
  1109	  //   and when it's checked by the navigation URL loader / handled in the
  1110	  //   renderer.
  1111	  // - mobile emulation disables plugins on the renderer side, but the browser
  1112	  //   navigation code is not aware of this.
  1113	  //
  1114	  // Similar to the missing archive resource case above, synthesise a resource
  1115	  // to commit.
  1116	  //
  1117	  // WebNavigationParams::FillStaticResponse() fills the response of |params|
  1118	  // using |params|'s |url| which is the initial URL even after redirections. So
  1119	  // updates the URL to the current URL before calling FillStaticResponse().
  1120	  params->url = params->response.CurrentRequestUrl();
  1121	  WebNavigationParams::FillStaticResponse(
  1122	      params, "text/html", "UTF-8",
  1123	      base::span_from_cstring(
  1124	          "<html><body>"
  1125	          "<!-- no enabled plugin supports this MIME type -->"
  1126	          "</body></html>"));
  1127	}
  1128	
  1129	// The browser navigation code should never send a `CommitNavigation()` request
  1130	// that fails this check.
  1131	static void AssertCanNavigate(WebNavigationParams* params, LocalFrame* frame) {
  1132	  if (params->is_static_data)
  1133	    return;
  1134	
  1135	  if (DocumentLoader::WillLoadUrlAsEmpty(params->url))
  1136	    return;
  1137	
  1138	  int status_code = params->response.HttpStatusCode();
  1139	  // If the server sends 204 or 205, this means the server does not want to
  1140	  // replace the page contents. However, PlzNavigate should have handled it
  1141	  // browser-side and never sent a commit request to the renderer.
  1142	  CHECK_NE(status_code, 204);
  1143	  CHECK_NE(status_code, 205);
  1144	
  1145	  // If the server attached a Content-Disposition indicating that the resource
  1146	  // is an attachment, this is actually a download. However, PlzNavigate should
  1147	  // have handled it browser-side and never sent a commit request to the
  1148	  // renderer.
  1149	  CHECK(!IsContentDispositionAttachment(
  1150	      params->response.HttpHeaderField(http_names::kContentDisposition)));
  1151	}
  1152	
  1153	void FrameLoader::CommitNavigation(
  1154	    std::unique_ptr<WebNavigationParams> navigation_params,
  1155	    std::unique_ptr<WebDocumentLoader::ExtraData> extra_data,
  1156	    CommitReason commit_reason) {
  1157	  TRACE_EVENT0("navigation", "FrameLoader::CommitNavigation");
  1158	  base::ScopedUmaHistogramTimer histogram_timer(
  1159	      "Navigation.FrameLoader.CommitNavigation");
  1160	  DCHECK(document_loader_);
  1161	  DCHECK(frame_->GetDocument());
  1162	  DCHECK(Client()->HasWebView());
  1163	
  1164	  if (!frame_->IsNavigationAllowed() ||
  1165	      frame_->GetDocument()->PageDismissalEventBeingDispatched() !=
  1166	          Document::kNoDismissal) {
  1167	    // Any of the checks above should not be necessary.
  1168	    // Unfortunately, in the case of sync IPCs like print() there might be
  1169	    // reentrancy and, for example, frame detach happening.
  1170	    // See fast/loader/detach-while-printing.html for a repro.
  1171	    // TODO(https://crbug.com/862088): we should probably ignore print()
  1172	    // call in this case instead.
  1173	    return;
  1174	  }
  1175	
  1176	  // The encoding may be inherited from the parent frame if the security context
  1177	  // allows it, but we don't have the frame's security context set up yet. In
  1178	  // this case avoid starting the body load since it requires the correct
  1179	  // encoding. We'll try again after the security context is set up in
  1180	  // DocumentLoader::CommitNavigation().
  1181	  const ResourceResponse& response =
  1182	      navigation_params->response.ToResourceResponse();
  1183	  if (!response.TextEncodingName().empty() ||
  1184	      !IsA<LocalFrame>(frame_->Tree().Parent())) {
  1185	    DocumentLoader::MaybeStartLoadingBodyInBackground(
  1186	        navigation_params->body_loader.get(), frame_.Get(),
  1187	        navigation_params->url, response);
  1188	  }
  1189	
  1190	  // TODO(dgozman): figure out the better place for this check
  1191	  // to cancel lazy load both on start and commit. Perhaps
  1192	  // CancelProvisionalLoaderForNewNavigation() is a good one.
  1193	  HTMLFrameOwnerElement* frame_owner = frame_->DeprecatedLocalOwner();
  1194	  if (frame_owner)
  1195	    frame_owner->CancelPendingLazyLoad();
  1196	
  1197	  // Note: we might actually classify this navigation as same document
  1198	  // right here in the following circumstances:
  1199	  // - the loader has already committed a navigation and notified the browser
  1200	  //   process which did not receive a message about that just yet;
  1201	  // - meanwhile, the browser process sent us a command to commit this new
  1202	  //   "cross-document" navigation, while it's actually same-document
  1203	  //   with regards to the last commit.
  1204	  // In this rare case, we intentionally proceed as cross-document.
  1205	
  1206	  if (!CancelProvisionalLoaderForNewNavigation())
  1207	    return;
  1208	
  1209	  FillStaticResponseIfNeeded(navigation_params.get(), frame_);
  1210	  AssertCanNavigate(navigation_params.get(), frame_);
  1211	
  1212	  // If this is a javascript: URL, XSLT commit or discard we must copy the
  1213	  // ExtraData from the previous DocumentLoader to ensure the new DocumentLoader
  1214	  // behaves the same way as the previous one.
  1215	  if (commit_reason == CommitReason::kXSLT ||
  1216	      commit_reason == CommitReason::kJavascriptUrl ||
  1217	      commit_reason == CommitReason::kDiscard) {
  1218	    // It is important to clone the previous loader's ExtraData instead of
  1219	    // extracting it since it may be needed to handle operations in the
  1220	    // document's unload handler (such as same-site navigation, see
  1221	    // crbug.com/361658816).
  1222	    DCHECK(!extra_data);
  1223	    extra_data = document_loader_->CloneExtraData();
  1224	  }
  1225	
  1226	  // Create the OldDocumentInfoForCommit for the old document (that might be in
  1227	  // another FrameLoader) and save it in ScopedOldDocumentInfoForCommitCapturer,
  1228	  // so that the old document can access it and fill in the information as it
  1229	  // is being unloaded/swapped out.
  1230	  auto url_origin = SecurityOrigin::Create(navigation_params->url);
  1231	  auto* info = MakeGarbageCollected<OldDocumentInfoForCommit>(url_origin);
  1232	  if (RuntimeEnabledFeatures::ResponsiveIframesEnabled()) {
  1233	    if (frame_->IsProvisional()) {
  1234	      if (const Frame* prev_frame = frame_->GetProvisionalOwnerFrame()) {
  1235	        info->old_document_origin =
  1236	            prev_frame->GetSecurityContext()->GetSecurityOrigin();
  1237	      }
  1238	    } else {
  1239	      info->old_document_origin =
  1240	          frame_->GetSecurityContext()->GetSecurityOrigin();
  1241	    }
  1242	  }
  1243	  ScopedOldDocumentInfoForCommitCapturer scoped_old_document_info(info);
  1244	  scoped_old_document_info.CurrentInfo()
  1245	      ->total_lifecycle_events_processing_time_on_commit =
  1246	      navigation_params->navigation_timings
  1247	          .total_lifecycle_events_processing_time_on_commit;
  1248	
  1249	  FrameSwapScope frame_swap_scope(frame_owner);
  1250	  {
  1251	    base::AutoReset<bool> scoped_committing(&committing_navigation_, true);
  1252	
  1253	    progress_tracker_->ProgressStarted();
  1254	    // In DocumentLoader, the matching DidCommitLoad messages are only called
  1255	    // for kRegular commits. Skip them here, too, to ensure we match
  1256	    // start/commit message pairs.
  1257	    if (commit_reason == CommitReason::kRegular) {
  1258	      frame_->GetFrameScheduler()->DidStartProvisionalLoad();
  1259	      probe::DidStartProvisionalLoad(frame_.Get());
  1260	    }
  1261	
  1262	    DCHECK(Client()->HasWebView());
  1263	
  1264	    // If `frame_` is provisional, `DetachDocument()` is largely a no-op other
  1265	    // than cleaning up the initial (and unused) empty document. Otherwise, this
  1266	    // unloads the previous Document and detaches subframes. If
  1267	    // `DetachDocument()` returns false, JS caused `frame_` to be removed, so
  1268	    // just return.
  1269	    const bool is_provisional = frame_->IsProvisional();
  1270	    // For an XSLT document, set SentDidFinishLoad now to prevent the
  1271	    // DocumentLoader from reporting an error when detaching the pre-XSLT
  1272	    // document.
  1273	    if (commit_reason == CommitReason::kXSLT && document_loader_) {
  1274	      DCHECK(
  1275	          XSLTProcessor::IsXSLTEnabled(frame_ ? frame_->DomWindow() : nullptr));
  1276	      document_loader_->SetSentDidFinishLoad();
  1277	      previous_document_loader_for_xslt_ = document_loader_.Get();
  1278	    }
  1279	    if (!DetachDocument()) {
  1280	      DCHECK(!is_provisional);
  1281	      return;
  1282	    }
  1283	
  1284	    // If the frame is provisional, swap it in now. However, if `SwapIn()`
  1285	    // returns false, JS caused `frame_` to be removed, so just return. In case
  1286	    // this triggers a local RenderFrame swap, it might trigger the unloading
  1287	    // of the old RenderFrame's document, updating the contents of the
  1288	    // OldDocumentInfoForCommit set in `scoped_old_document_info` above.
  1289	    // NOTE: it's important that SwapIn() happens before DetachDocument(),
  1290	    // because this ensures that the unload timing info generated by detaching
  1291	    // the provisional frame's document isn't the one that gets used.
  1292	    if (is_provisional && !frame_->SwapIn())
  1293	      return;
  1294	  }
  1295	
  1296	  tls_version_warning_origins_.clear();
  1297	
  1298	  if (!navigation_params->is_synchronous_commit_for_bug_778318 ||
  1299	      (!navigation_params->url.IsEmpty() &&
  1300	       !KURL(navigation_params->url).IsAboutBlankUrl())) {
  1301	    // The new document is not the synchronously committed about:blank document,
  1302	    // so lose the initial empty document status.
  1303	    // Note 1: The actual initial empty document commit (with commit_reason set
  1304	    // to CommitReason::kInitialization) won't go through this path since it
  1305	    // immediately commits the DocumentLoader, so we only check for the
  1306	    // synchronous about:blank commit here.
  1307	    // Note 2: Even if the navigation is a synchronous one, it might be a
  1308	    // non-about:blank/empty URL commit that is accidentally got caught by the
  1309	    // synchronous about:blank path but can't easily be removed due to failing
  1310	    // tests/compatibility risk (e.g. about:mumble).
  1311	    // TODO(https://crbug.com/1215096): Tighten the conditions in
  1312	    // RenderFrameImpl::BeginNavigation() for a navigation to enter the
  1313	    // synchronous commit path to only accept about:blank or an empty URL which
  1314	    // defaults to about:blank, per the spec:
  1315	    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/iframe-embed-object.html#the-iframe-element:about:blank
  1316	    DCHECK_NE(commit_reason, CommitReason::kInitialization);
  1317	    SetIsNotOnInitialEmptyDocument();
  1318	  }
  1319	
  1320	  // TODO(dgozman): navigation type should probably be passed by the caller.
  1321	  // It seems incorrect to pass |false| for |have_event| and then use
  1322	  // determined navigation type to update resource request.
  1323	  WebNavigationType navigation_type = DetermineNavigationType(
  1324	      navigation_params->frame_load_type,
  1325	      !navigation_params->http_body.IsNull(), false /* have_event */);
  1326	
  1327	  std::unique_ptr<PolicyContainer> policy_container;
  1328	  if (navigation_params->policy_container) {
  1329	    // Javascript and xslt documents should not change the PolicyContainer.
  1330	    DCHECK(commit_reason == CommitReason::kRegular);
  1331	
  1332	    policy_container = PolicyContainer::CreateFromWebPolicyContainer(
  1333	        std::move(navigation_params->policy_container));
  1334	  }
  1335	
  1336	  // TODO(dgozman): get rid of provisional document loader and most of the code
  1337	  // below. We should probably call DocumentLoader::CommitNavigation directly.
  1338	  DocumentLoader* new_document_loader = MakeGarbageCollected<DocumentLoader>(
  1339	      frame_, navigation_type, std::move(navigation_params),
  1340	      std::move(policy_container), std::move(extra_data));
  1341	
  1342	  if (previous_document_loader_for_xslt_) {
  1343	    DCHECK(
  1344	        XSLTProcessor::IsXSLTEnabled(frame_ ? frame_->DomWindow() : nullptr));
  1345	    new_document_loader->InheritXsltUseCountersFrom(
  1346	        previous_document_loader_for_xslt_);
  1347	    previous_document_loader_for_xslt_ = nullptr;
  1348	  }
  1349	
  1350	  CommitDocumentLoader(
  1351	      new_document_loader,
  1352	      ScopedOldDocumentInfoForCommitCapturer::CurrentInfo()->history_item.Get(),
  1353	      commit_reason);
  1354	
  1355	  RestoreScrollPositionAndViewState();
  1356	
  1357	  if (!frame_->IsDetached() && frame_->IsOutermostMainFrame()) {
  1358	    ukm::builders::PageLifecycleMetricsOnNewPageCommit(
  1359	        frame_->GetDocument()->UkmSourceID())
  1360	        .SetPageLifecycleEventsTotalProcessingTime(
  1361	            ukm::GetExponentialBucketMinForFineUserTiming(
  1362	                scoped_old_document_info.CurrentInfo()
  1363	                    ->total_lifecycle_events_processing_time_on_commit
  1364	                    .InMilliseconds()))
  1365	        .Record(frame_->GetDocument()->UkmRecorder());
  1366	  }
  1367	
  1368	  TakeObjectSnapshot();
  1369	}
  1370	
  1371	bool FrameLoader::WillStartNavigation(const WebNavigationInfo& info) {
  1372	  if (!CancelProvisionalLoaderForNewNavigation())
  1373	    return false;
  1374	
  1375	  progress_tracker_->ProgressStarted();
  1376	  client_navigation_ = std::make_unique<ClientNavigationState>();
  1377	  client_navigation_->url = info.url_request.Url();
  1378	  frame_->GetFrameScheduler()->DidStartProvisionalLoad();
  1379	  probe::DidStartProvisionalLoad(frame_.Get());
  1380	  virtual_time_pauser_.PauseVirtualTime();
  1381	  TakeObjectSnapshot();
  1382	  return true;
  1383	}
  1384	
  1385	void FrameLoader::StopAllLoaders(bool abort_client) {
  1386	  if (!frame_->IsNavigationAllowed() ||
  1387	      frame_->GetDocument()->PageDismissalEventBeingDispatched() !=
  1388	          Document::kNoDismissal) {
  1389	    return;
  1390	  }
  1391	
  1392	  // This method could be called from within this method, e.g. through plugin
  1393	  // detach. Avoid infinite recursion by disabling navigations.
  1394	  FrameNavigationDisabler navigation_disabler(*frame_);
  1395	
  1396	  for (Frame* child = frame_->Tree().FirstChild(); child;
  1397	       child = child->Tree().NextSibling()) {
  1398	    if (auto* child_local_frame = DynamicTo<LocalFrame>(child))
  1399	      child_local_frame->Loader().StopAllLoaders(abort_client);
  1400	  }
  1401	
  1402	  frame_->GetDocument()->CancelParsing();
  1403	
  1404	  // `abort_client` is false only when we are stopping all loading in
  1405	  // preparation for a frame swap. When a swap occurs, we're stopping all
  1406	  // loading in this particular LocalFrame, but the conceptual frame is
  1407	  // committing and continuing loading. We shouldn't treat this as a navigation
  1408	  // cancellation in web-observable ways, so the navigation API should not do
  1409	  // its cancelled navigation steps (e.g., firing a navigateerror event).
  1410	  if (abort_client) {
  1411	    frame_->DomWindow()->navigation()->InformAboutCanceledNavigation();
  1412	  }
  1413	
  1414	  if (document_loader_)
  1415	    document_loader_->StopLoading();
  1416	  if (abort_client)
  1417	    CancelClientNavigation();
  1418	  else
  1419	    ClearClientNavigation();
  1420	  frame_->CancelFormSubmission();
  1421	  DidFinishNavigation(FrameLoader::NavigationFinishState::kSuccess);
  1422	
  1423	  TakeObjectSnapshot();
  1424	}
  1425	
  1426	void FrameLoader::DidAccessInitialDocument() {
  1427	  if (frame_->IsMainFrame() && !has_accessed_initial_document_) {
  1428	    has_accessed_initial_document_ = true;
  1429	    // Forbid script execution to prevent re-entering V8, since this is called
  1430	    // from a binding security check.
  1431	    ScriptForbiddenScope forbid_scripts;
  1432	    frame_->GetPage()->GetChromeClient().DidAccessInitialMainDocument();
  1433	  }
  1434	}
  1435	
  1436	bool FrameLoader::DetachDocument() {
  1437	  TRACE_EVENT0("navigation", "FrameLoader::DetachDocument");
  1438	  base::ScopedUmaHistogramTimer histogram_timer(
  1439	      "Navigation.FrameLoader.DetachDocument");
  1440	  DCHECK(frame_->GetDocument());
  1441	  DCHECK(document_loader_);
  1442	
  1443	  ClientNavigationState* client_navigation = client_navigation_.get();
  1444	
  1445	  // Don't allow this frame to navigate anymore. This line is needed for
  1446	  // navigation triggered from children's unload handlers. Blocking navigations
  1447	  // triggered from this frame's unload handler is already covered in
  1448	  // DispatchUnloadEventAndFillOldDocumentInfoIfNeeded().
  1449	  FrameNavigationDisabler navigation_disabler(*frame_);
  1450	  // Don't allow any new child frames to load in this frame: attaching a new
  1451	  // child frame during or after detaching children results in an attached frame
  1452	  // on a detached DOM tree, which is bad.
  1453	  SubframeLoadingDisabler disabler(frame_->GetDocument());
  1454	  // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/C/browsing-the-web.html#unload-a-document
  1455	  // The ignore-opens-during-unload counter of a Document must be incremented
  1456	  // both when unloading itself and when unloading its descendants.
  1457	  IgnoreOpensDuringUnloadCountIncrementer ignore_opens_during_unload(
  1458	      frame_->GetDocument());
  1459	  DispatchUnloadEventAndFillOldDocumentInfoIfNeeded(
  1460	      true /* will_commit_new_document_in_this_frame */);
  1461	  frame_->DetachChildren();
  1462	  // The previous calls to DispatchUnloadEventAndFillOldDocumentInfoIfNeeded()
  1463	  // and detachChildren() can execute arbitrary script via things like unload
  1464	  // events. If the executed script causes the current frame to be detached, we
  1465	  // need to abandon the current load.
  1466	  if (!frame_->Client())
  1467	    return false;
  1468	  // FrameNavigationDisabler should prevent another load from starting.
  1469	  DCHECK_EQ(client_navigation_.get(), client_navigation);
  1470	  // Detaching the document loader will abort XHRs that haven't completed, which
  1471	  // can trigger event listeners for 'abort'. These event listeners might call
  1472	  // window.stop(), which will in turn detach the provisional document loader.
  1473	  // At this point, the provisional document loader should not detach, because
  1474	  // then the FrameLoader would not have any attached DocumentLoaders. This is
  1475	  // guaranteed by FrameNavigationDisabler above.
  1476	  DetachDocumentLoader(document_loader_, true);
  1477	  // 'abort' listeners can also detach the frame.
  1478	  if (!frame_->Client())
  1479	    return false;
  1480	  // FrameNavigationDisabler should prevent another load from starting.
  1481	  DCHECK_EQ(client_navigation_.get(), client_navigation);
  1482	
  1483	  // No more events will be dispatched so detach the Document.
  1484	  // TODO(dcheng): Why is this a conditional check?
  1485	  // TODO(yoav): Should we also be nullifying domWindow's document (or
  1486	  // domWindow) since the doc is now detached?
  1487	  frame_->GetDocument()->Shutdown();
  1488	  document_loader_ = nullptr;
  1489	
  1490	  return true;
  1491	}
  1492	
  1493	void FrameLoader::CommitDocumentLoader(DocumentLoader* document_loader,
  1494	                                       HistoryItem* previous_history_item,
  1495	                                       CommitReason commit_reason) {
  1496	  TRACE_EVENT0("navigation", "FrameLoader::CommitDocumentLoader");
  1497	  base::ScopedUmaHistogramTimer histogram_timer(
  1498	      "Navigation.FrameLoader.CommitDocumentLoader");
  1499	  base::ElapsedTimer timer;
  1500	  document_loader_ = document_loader;
  1501	  CHECK(document_loader_);
  1502	
  1503	  document_loader_->SetCommitReason(commit_reason);
  1504	  document_loader_->StartLoading();
  1505	
  1506	  if (commit_reason != CommitReason::kInitialization) {
  1507	    // Following the call to StartLoading, the DocumentLoader state has taken
  1508	    // into account all redirects that happened during navigation. Its
  1509	    // HistoryItem can be properly updated for the commit, using the HistoryItem
  1510	    // of the previous Document.
  1511	    document_loader_->SetHistoryItemStateForCommit(
  1512	        previous_history_item, document_loader_->LoadType(),
  1513	        DocumentLoader::HistoryNavigationType::kDifferentDocument,
  1514	        commit_reason);
  1515	  }
  1516	
  1517	  // Update the DocumentLoadTiming with the timings from the previous document
  1518	  // unload event.
  1519	  OldDocumentInfoForCommit* old_document_info =
  1520	      ScopedOldDocumentInfoForCommitCapturer::CurrentInfo();
  1521	  if (old_document_info &&
  1522	      old_document_info->unload_timing_info.unload_timing.has_value()) {
  1523	    document_loader_->GetTiming().SetCanRequestFromPreviousDocument(
  1524	        old_document_info->unload_timing_info.unload_timing->can_request);
  1525	    document_loader_->GetTiming().SetUnloadEventStart(
  1526	        old_document_info->unload_timing_info.unload_timing
  1527	            ->unload_event_start);
  1528	    document_loader_->GetTiming().SetUnloadEventEnd(
  1529	        old_document_info->unload_timing_info.unload_timing->unload_event_end);
  1530	    document_loader_->GetTiming().MarkCommitNavigationEnd();
  1531	  }
  1532	
  1533	  TakeObjectSnapshot();
  1534	
  1535	  Client()->TransitionToCommittedForNewPage();
  1536	
  1537	  document_loader_->CommitNavigation();
  1538	
  1539	  base::UmaHistogramTimes("Blink.CommitDocumentLoaderTime", timer.Elapsed());
  1540	  ukm::builders::Blink_FrameLoader(frame_->GetDocument()->UkmSourceID())
  1541	      .SetCommitDocumentLoaderTime(ukm::GetExponentialBucketMinForUserTiming(
  1542	          timer.Elapsed().InMicroseconds()))
  1543	      .Record(frame_->GetDocument()->UkmRecorder());
  1544	}
  1545	
  1546	void FrameLoader::RestoreScrollPositionAndViewState() {
  1547	  if (!frame_->GetPage() || !GetDocumentLoader() ||
  1548	      !GetDocumentLoader()->GetHistoryItem() ||
  1549	      !GetDocumentLoader()->GetHistoryItem()->GetViewState() ||
  1550	      !GetDocumentLoader()->NavigationScrollAllowed()) {
  1551	    return;
  1552	  }
  1553	
  1554	  // We need to suppress scroll restoration animations for navigations with
  1555	  // visual transitions for the same-document case only. This is done in
  1556	  // ProcessScrollForSameDocumentNavigation.
  1557	  //
  1558	  // For cross-document navigations (which take this path) the animation is
  1559	  // suppressed by default.
  1560	  RestoreScrollPositionAndViewState(
  1561	      GetDocumentLoader()->LoadType(),
  1562	      *GetDocumentLoader()->GetHistoryItem()->GetViewState(),
  1563	      GetDocumentLoader()->GetHistoryItem()->ScrollRestorationType(),
  1564	      mojom::blink::ScrollBehavior::kAuto);
  1565	}
  1566	
  1567	void FrameLoader::RestoreScrollPositionAndViewState(
  1568	    WebFrameLoadType load_type,
  1569	    const HistoryItem::ViewState& view_state,
  1570	    mojom::blink::ScrollRestorationType scroll_restoration_type,
  1571	    mojom::blink::ScrollBehavior scroll_behavior) {
  1572	  LocalFrameView* view = frame_->View();
  1573	  if (!view || !view->LayoutViewport() || !frame_->IsAttached() ||
  1574	      frame_->GetDocument()->IsInitialEmptyDocument()) {
  1575	    return;
  1576	  }
  1577	  if (!NeedsHistoryItemRestore(load_type))
  1578	    return;
  1579	
  1580	  view->LayoutViewport()->SetPendingHistoryRestoreScrollOffset(
  1581	      view_state,
  1582	      scroll_restoration_type != mojom::blink::ScrollRestorationType::kManual,
  1583	      scroll_behavior);
  1584	  view->GetScrollableArea()->SetPendingHistoryRestoreScrollOffset(
  1585	      view_state,
  1586	      scroll_restoration_type != mojom::blink::ScrollRestorationType::kManual,
  1587	      scroll_behavior);
  1588	
  1589	  view->ScheduleAnimation();
  1590	}
  1591	
  1592	String FrameLoader::ApplyUserAgentOverride(const String& user_agent) const {
  1593	  String user_agent_override;
  1594	  probe::ApplyUserAgentOverride(probe::ToCoreProbeSink(frame_->GetDocument()),
  1595	                                &user_agent_override);
  1596	
  1597	  if (Client()->UserAgentOverride().empty() && user_agent_override.empty()) {
  1598	    return user_agent;
  1599	  }
  1600	
  1601	  if (user_agent_override.empty()) {
  1602	    user_agent_override = user_agent;
  1603	  }
  1604	
  1605	  return user_agent_override;
  1606	}
  1607	
  1608	String FrameLoader::UserAgent() const {
  1609	  return ApplyUserAgentOverride(Client()->UserAgent());
  1610	}
  1611	
  1612	std::optional<blink::UserAgentMetadata> FrameLoader::UserAgentMetadata() const {
  1613	  return Client()->UserAgentMetadata();
  1614	}
  1615	
  1616	void FrameLoader::Detach() {
  1617	  frame_->GetDocument()->CancelParsing();
  1618	  DetachDocumentLoader(document_loader_);
  1619	  ClearClientNavigation();
  1620	  committing_navigation_ = false;
  1621	  DidFinishNavigation(FrameLoader::NavigationFinishState::kSuccess);
  1622	
  1623	  if (progress_tracker_) {
  1624	    progress_tracker_->Dispose();
  1625	    progress_tracker_.Clear();
  1626	  }
  1627	
  1628	  TRACE_EVENT_INSTANT(
  1629	      "loading", "FrameLoader:deleted",
  1630	      perfetto::TerminatingFlow::FromPointer(this, "FrameLoader"));
  1631	  state_ = State::kDetached;
  1632	  virtual_time_pauser_.UnpauseVirtualTime();
  1633	}
  1634	
  1635	bool FrameLoader::ShouldPerformFragmentNavigation(bool is_form_submission,
  1636	                                                  const String& http_method,
  1637	                                                  WebFrameLoadType load_type,
  1638	                                                  const KURL& url) {
  1639	  // We don't do this if we are submitting a form with method other than "GET",
  1640	  // explicitly reloading, currently displaying a frameset, or if the URL does
  1641	  // not have a fragment.
  1642	  return EqualIgnoringAsciiCase(http_method, http_names::kGET) &&
  1643	         !IsReloadLoadType(load_type) && !IsBackForwardOrRestore(load_type) &&
  1644	         url.HasFragmentIdentifier() &&
  1645	         // For provisional LocalFrame, there is no real document loaded and
  1646	         // the initial empty document should not be considered, so there is
  1647	         // no way to get a same-document load in this case.
  1648	         !frame_->IsProvisional() &&
  1649	         EqualIgnoringFragmentIdentifier(frame_->GetDocument()->Url(), url)
  1650	         // We don't want to just scroll if a link from within a frameset is
  1651	         // trying to reload the frameset into _top.
  1652	         && !frame_->GetDocument()->IsFrameSet();
  1653	}
  1654	
  1655	void FrameLoader::ProcessFragment(const KURL& url,
  1656	                                  WebFrameLoadType frame_load_type,
  1657	                                  LoadStartType load_start_type) {
  1658	  LocalFrameView* view = frame_->View();
  1659	  if (!view)
  1660	    return;
  1661	
  1662	  const bool is_same_document_navigation =
  1663	      load_start_type == kNavigationWithinSameDocument;
  1664	
  1665	  // Pages can opt-in to manual scroll restoration so the page will handle
  1666	  // restoring the past scroll offset during a history navigation. In these
  1667	  // cases we assume the scroll was restored from history (by the page).
  1668	  const bool uses_manual_scroll_restoration =
  1669	      IsBackForwardOrRestore(frame_load_type) &&
  1670	      GetDocumentLoader()->GetHistoryItem() &&
  1671	      GetDocumentLoader()->GetHistoryItem()->ScrollRestorationType() ==
  1672	          mojom::blink::ScrollRestorationType::kManual;
  1673	
  1674	  // If we restored a scroll position from history, we shouldn't clobber it
  1675	  // with the fragment.
  1676	  const bool will_restore_scroll_from_history =
  1677	      GetDocumentLoader()->GetInitialScrollState().did_restore_from_history ||
  1678	      uses_manual_scroll_restoration;
  1679	
  1680	  // Scrolling at load can be blocked by document policy. This policy applies
  1681	  // only to cross-document navigations.
  1682	  const bool blocked_by_policy =
  1683	      !is_same_document_navigation &&
  1684	      !GetDocumentLoader()->NavigationScrollAllowed();
  1685	
  1686	  // We should avoid scrolling the fragment if it would clobber a history
  1687	  // restored scroll state but still allow it on same document navigations
  1688	  // after (i.e. if we navigate back and restore the scroll position, the user
  1689	  // should still be able to click on a same-document fragment link and have it
  1690	  // jump to the anchor).
  1691	  const bool is_same_document_non_history_nav =
  1692	      is_same_document_navigation && !IsBackForwardOrRestore(frame_load_type);
  1693	
  1694	  const bool block_fragment_scroll =
  1695	      blocked_by_policy ||
  1696	      (will_restore_scroll_from_history && !is_same_document_non_history_nav);
  1697	
  1698	  view->ProcessUrlFragment(url, is_same_document_navigation,
  1699	                           !block_fragment_scroll);
  1700	}
  1701	
  1702	bool FrameLoader::ShouldClose(
  1703	    bool is_reload,
  1704	    bool force_to_proceed,
  1705	    base::TimeTicks& out_before_unload_dialog_opened_time,
  1706	    base::TimeTicks& out_before_unload_dialog_closed_time) {
  1707	  TRACE_EVENT("loading", "FrameLoader::ShouldClose", "is_reload", is_reload,
  1708	              "force_to_proceed", force_to_proceed);
  1709	  const base::TimeTicks before_unload_events_start = base::TimeTicks::Now();
  1710	
  1711	  Page* page = frame_->GetPage();
  1712	  if (!page || !page->GetChromeClient().CanOpenBeforeUnloadConfirmPanel())
  1713	    return true;
  1714	
  1715	  HeapVector<Member<LocalFrame>> descendant_frames;
  1716	  for (Frame* child = frame_->Tree().FirstChild(); child;
  1717	       child = child->Tree().TraverseNext(frame_.Get())) {
  1718	    // FIXME: There is not yet any way to dispatch events to out-of-process
  1719	    // frames.
  1720	    if (auto* child_local_frame = DynamicTo<LocalFrame>(child))
  1721	      descendant_frames.push_back(child_local_frame);
  1722	  }
  1723	
  1724	  {
  1725	    FrameNavigationDisabler navigation_disabler(*frame_);
  1726	    bool did_allow_navigation = false;
  1727	
  1728	    // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/C/browsing-the-web.html#prompt-to-unload-a-document
  1729	
  1730	    // First deal with this frame.
  1731	    IgnoreOpensDuringUnloadCountIncrementer ignore_opens_during_unload(
  1732	        frame_->GetDocument());
  1733	    if (!frame_->GetDocument()->DispatchBeforeUnloadEvent(
  1734	            &page->GetChromeClient(), is_reload, force_to_proceed,
  1735	            did_allow_navigation, out_before_unload_dialog_opened_time,
  1736	            out_before_unload_dialog_closed_time)) {
  1737	      frame_->DomWindow()->navigation()->InformAboutCanceledNavigation();
  1738	      return false;
  1739	    }
  1740	
  1741	    // Then deal with descendent frames.
  1742	    for (Member<LocalFrame>& descendant_frame : descendant_frames) {
  1743	      if (!descendant_frame->Tree().IsDescendantOf(frame_.Get())) {
  1744	        continue;
  1745	      }
  1746	
  1747	      // There is some confusion in the spec around what counters should be
  1748	      // incremented for a descendant browsing context:
  1749	      // https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/3899
  1750	      //
  1751	      // Here for implementation ease, we use the current spec behavior, which
