  1752	      // is to increment only the counter of the Document on which this is
  1753	      // called, and that of the Document we are firing the beforeunload event
  1754	      // on -- not any intermediate Documents that may be the parent of the
  1755	      // frame being unloaded but is not root Document.
  1756	      IgnoreOpensDuringUnloadCountIncrementer
  1757	          ignore_opens_during_unload_descendant(
  1758	              descendant_frame->GetDocument());
  1759	      if (!descendant_frame->GetDocument()->DispatchBeforeUnloadEvent(
  1760	              &page->GetChromeClient(), is_reload, force_to_proceed,
  1761	              did_allow_navigation, out_before_unload_dialog_opened_time,
  1762	              out_before_unload_dialog_closed_time)) {
  1763	        frame_->DomWindow()->navigation()->InformAboutCanceledNavigation();
  1764	        return false;
  1765	      }
  1766	    }
  1767	  }
  1768	
  1769	  // Now that none of the unloading frames canceled the BeforeUnload, tell each
  1770	  // of them so they can advance to the appropriate load state.
  1771	  frame_->GetDocument()->BeforeUnloadDoneWillUnload();
  1772	  for (Member<LocalFrame>& descendant_frame : descendant_frames) {
  1773	    if (!descendant_frame->Tree().IsDescendantOf(frame_.Get())) {
  1774	      continue;
  1775	    }
  1776	    descendant_frame->GetDocument()->BeforeUnloadDoneWillUnload();
  1777	  }
  1778	
  1779	  if (!is_reload) {
  1780	    // Records only when a non-reload navigation occurs.
  1781	    base::UmaHistogramMediumTimes(
  1782	        "Navigation.OnBeforeUnloadTotalTime",
  1783	        base::TimeTicks::Now() - before_unload_events_start);
  1784	  }
  1785	
  1786	  return true;
  1787	}
  1788	
  1789	void FrameLoader::DidDropNavigation() {
  1790	  if (!client_navigation_)
  1791	    return;
  1792	  // TODO(dgozman): should we ClearClientNavigation instead and not
  1793	  // notify the client in response to its own call?
  1794	  CancelClientNavigation(CancelNavigationReason::kDropped);
  1795	  DidFinishNavigation(FrameLoader::NavigationFinishState::kSuccess);
  1796	
  1797	  // Forcibly instantiate WindowProxy for initial frame document.
  1798	  // This is only required when frame navigation is aborted, e.g. due to
  1799	  // mixed content.
  1800	  // TODO(lushnikov): this should be done in Init for initial empty doc, but
  1801	  // that breaks extensions abusing SetForceMainWorldInitialization setting
  1802	  // and relying on the number of created window proxies.
  1803	  Settings* settings = frame_->GetSettings();
  1804	  if (settings && settings->GetForceMainWorldInitialization()) {
  1805	    auto* window = frame_->DomWindow();
  1806	    // Forcibly instantiate WindowProxy.
  1807	    window->GetScriptController().WindowProxy(
  1808	        DOMWrapperWorld::MainWorld(window->GetIsolate()));
  1809	  }
  1810	  frame_->GetIdlenessDetector()->DidDropNavigation();
  1811	}
  1812	
  1813	bool FrameLoader::CancelProvisionalLoaderForNewNavigation() {
  1814	  // This seems to correspond to step 9 of the specification:
  1815	  // "9. Abort the active document of browsingContext."
  1816	  // https://html.spec.whatwg.org/C/#navigate
  1817	  frame_->GetDocument()->Abort();
  1818	  // document.onreadystatechange can fire in Abort(), which can:
  1819	  // 1) Detach this frame.
  1820	  // 2) Stop the provisional DocumentLoader (i.e window.stop()).
  1821	  if (!frame_->GetPage())
  1822	    return false;
  1823	
  1824	  // For client navigations, don't send failure callbacks when simply
  1825	  // replacing client navigation with a DocumentLoader.
  1826	  ClearClientNavigation();
  1827	
  1828	  // Cancel pending form submissions so they don't take precedence over this.
  1829	  frame_->CancelFormSubmission();
  1830	
  1831	  return true;
  1832	}
  1833	
  1834	void FrameLoader::ClearClientNavigation() {
  1835	  if (!client_navigation_)
  1836	    return;
  1837	  client_navigation_.reset();
  1838	  probe::DidFailProvisionalLoad(frame_.Get());
  1839	  virtual_time_pauser_.UnpauseVirtualTime();
  1840	}
  1841	
  1842	void FrameLoader::CancelClientNavigation(CancelNavigationReason reason) {
  1843	  if (!client_navigation_)
  1844	    return;
  1845	
  1846	  frame_->DomWindow()->navigation()->InformAboutCanceledNavigation(reason);
  1847	
  1848	  ResourceError error = ResourceError::CancelledError(client_navigation_->url);
  1849	  ClearClientNavigation();
  1850	  if (WebPluginContainerImpl* plugin = frame_->GetWebPluginContainer())
  1851	    plugin->DidFailLoading(error);
  1852	  Client()->AbortClientNavigation(reason ==
  1853	                                  CancelNavigationReason::kNewNavigation);
  1854	}
  1855	
  1856	void FrameLoader::DispatchDocumentElementAvailable() {
  1857	  ScriptForbiddenScope forbid_scripts;
  1858	
  1859	  // Notify the browser about documents loading in the top frame.
  1860	  if (frame_->GetDocument()->Url().IsValid() && frame_->IsMainFrame()) {
  1861	    // For now, don't remember plugin zoom values.  We don't want to mix them
  1862	    // with normal web content (i.e. a fixed layout plugin would usually want
  1863	    // them different).
  1864	    frame_->GetLocalFrameHostRemote().MainDocumentElementAvailable(
  1865	        frame_->GetDocument()->IsPluginDocument());
  1866	  }
  1867	
  1868	  Client()->DocumentElementAvailable();
  1869	}
  1870	
  1871	void FrameLoader::RunScriptsAtDocumentElementAvailable() {
  1872	  Client()->RunScriptsAtDocumentElementAvailable();
  1873	  // The frame might be detached at this point.
  1874	}
  1875	
  1876	void FrameLoader::DispatchDidClearDocumentOfWindowObject() {
  1877	  if (state_ == State::kUninitialized)
  1878	    return;
  1879	
  1880	  Settings* settings = frame_->GetSettings();
  1881	  LocalDOMWindow* window = frame_->DomWindow();
  1882	  if (settings && settings->GetForceMainWorldInitialization()) {
  1883	    // Forcibly instantiate WindowProxy, even if script is disabled.
  1884	    window->GetScriptController().WindowProxy(
  1885	        DOMWrapperWorld::MainWorld(window->GetIsolate()));
  1886	  }
  1887	  probe::DidClearDocumentOfWindowObject(frame_.Get());
  1888	  if (!window->CanExecuteScripts(kNotAboutToExecuteScript))
  1889	    return;
  1890	
  1891	  if (dispatching_did_clear_window_object_in_main_world_)
  1892	    return;
  1893	  base::AutoReset<bool> in_did_clear_window_object(
  1894	      &dispatching_did_clear_window_object_in_main_world_, true);
  1895	  // We just cleared the document, not the entire window object, but for the
  1896	  // embedder that's close enough.
  1897	  Client()->DispatchDidClearWindowObjectInMainWorld(window);
  1898	}
  1899	
  1900	void FrameLoader::DispatchDidClearWindowObjectInMainWorld() {
  1901	  LocalDOMWindow* window = frame_->DomWindow();
  1902	  if (!window->CanExecuteScripts(kNotAboutToExecuteScript))
  1903	    return;
  1904	
  1905	  if (dispatching_did_clear_window_object_in_main_world_)
  1906	    return;
  1907	  base::AutoReset<bool> in_did_clear_window_object(
  1908	      &dispatching_did_clear_window_object_in_main_world_, true);
  1909	  Client()->DispatchDidClearWindowObjectInMainWorld(window);
  1910	}
  1911	
  1912	network::mojom::blink::WebSandboxFlags
  1913	FrameLoader::PendingEffectiveSandboxFlags() const {
  1914	  if (Frame* parent = frame_->Tree().Parent()) {
  1915	    return parent->GetSecurityContext()->GetSandboxFlags() |
  1916	           frame_->Owner()->GetFramePolicy().sandbox_flags;
  1917	  } else {
  1918	    return frame_->OpenerSandboxFlags();
  1919	  }
  1920	}
  1921	
  1922	void FrameLoader::ModifyRequestForCSP(
  1923	    ResourceRequest& resource_request,
  1924	    const FetchClientSettingsObject* fetch_client_settings_object,
  1925	    LocalDOMWindow* window_for_logging,
  1926	    mojom::RequestContextFrameType frame_type) const {
  1927	  // Tack an 'Upgrade-Insecure-Requests' header to outgoing navigational
  1928	  // requests, as described in
  1929	  // https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-upgrade-insecure-requests/#feature-detect
  1930	  if (frame_type != mojom::RequestContextFrameType::kNone) {
  1931	    // Early return if the request has already been upgraded.
  1932	    if (!resource_request.HttpHeaderField(http_names::kUpgradeInsecureRequests)
  1933	             .IsNull()) {
  1934	      return;
  1935	    }
  1936	
  1937	    resource_request.SetHttpHeaderField(http_names::kUpgradeInsecureRequests,
  1938	                                        AtomicString("1"));
  1939	  }
  1940	
  1941	  MixedContentChecker::UpgradeInsecureRequest(
  1942	      resource_request, fetch_client_settings_object, window_for_logging,
  1943	      frame_type, frame_->GetContentSettingsClient(), frame_);
  1944	}
  1945	
  1946	void FrameLoader::WriteIntoTrace(perfetto::TracedValue context) const {
  1947	  auto dict = std::move(context).WriteDictionary();
  1948	  {
  1949	    auto frame_dict = dict.AddDictionary("frame");
  1950	    frame_dict.Add("id_ref", IdentifiersFactory::FrameId(frame_.Get()));
  1951	  }
  1952	  dict.Add("isLoadingMainFrame", frame_->IsMainFrame());
  1953	  dict.Add("isOutermostMainFrame", frame_->IsOutermostMainFrame());
  1954	  dict.Add("documentLoaderURL",
  1955	           document_loader_ ? document_loader_->Url().GetString() : String());
  1956	}
  1957	
  1958	inline void FrameLoader::TakeObjectSnapshot() const {
  1959	  if (state_ == State::kDetached) {
  1960	    // We already logged TRACE_EVENT_OBJECT_DELETED_WITH_ID in detach().
  1961	    return;
  1962	  }
  1963	  TRACE_EVENT_INSTANT("loading", "FrameLoader:state_snapshot",
  1964	                      perfetto::Flow::FromPointer(this, "FrameLoader"),
  1965	                      "snapshot", *this);
  1966	}
  1967	
  1968	mojo::PendingRemote<mojom::blink::CodeCacheHost>
  1969	FrameLoader::CreateWorkerCodeCacheHost() {
  1970	  if (!document_loader_)
  1971	    return mojo::NullRemote();
  1972	  return document_loader_->CreateCodeCacheHost();
  1973	}
  1974	
  1975	void FrameLoader::ProcessPendingCrossDocumentFragment() {
  1976	  if (!has_pending_cross_document_fragment_) {
  1977	    return;
  1978	  }
  1979	  has_pending_cross_document_fragment_ = false;
  1980	  ProcessFragment(frame_->GetDocument()->Url(), document_loader_->LoadType(),
  1981	                  kNavigationToDifferentDocument);
  1982	}
  1983	
  1984	}  // namespace blink
  1985
